description_zh: 该接口用于创建RDS AI应用实例
kebab_example: aliyun rdsai create-app-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --app-type supabase --vswitch-id vsw-9dp2hkpm22gxscfgy0000 --instance-class rdsai.supabase.basic --db-instance-name pgm-2ze49qv594vi0000 --app-name test-supabase --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz0000 --database-password test_Password --dashboard-username supabase --dashboard-password test_Password --public-network-access-enabled false --rag-enabled false --db-instance-config DBInstanceClass=pg.n2.2c.1m DBInstanceStorage=100 PayType=Postpaid --public-endpoint-enabled true --initialize-with-existing-data false --components Type=supabase --database test_database_01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAppInstance

parameters.help_en: The operation that you want to perform. Set the value to CreateAppInstance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: app_type

parameters.help_en: The application type. Only supabase is supported
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_zh: 实例的规格。当前仅支持rdsai.supabase.basic
parameters.name: instance_class

parameters.help_en: The instance type. Only rdsai.supabase.basic is supported
parameters.help_zh:
AI应用接入的RDS PostgreSQL数据库实例ID。

<notice>仅支持新购的RDS PostgreSQL空实例，且其大版本为17，小版本为20250630及以上。></notice>
parameters.name: db_instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the RDS for PostgreSQL instance with which the RDS Supabase instances are associated.

: Only newly purchased empty RDS for PostgreSQL instances are supported. The major engine version must be PostgreSQL 17 and the minor version must be 20250630 or later
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the new AI application
parameters.help_zh: 幂等参数。由客户端生成该参数值，用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests
parameters.help_zh:
RDS数据库访问密码。

密码长度为8～32位，且必须包含三种及以上以下字符：大写字母、小写字母、数字、下划线（_）
parameters.name: database_password

parameters.help_en:
The password used to access the RDS database.

The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length and must contain at least three of the following characters: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_)
parameters.name: dashboard_username

parameters.help_zh:
Supabase Dashboard密码。

密码长度为8～32位，且必须包含三种及以上以下字符：大写字母、小写字母、数字、下划线（_）
parameters.name: dashboard_password

parameters.help_en:
The Supabase Dashboard password.

The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length and must contain at least three of the following characters: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启公网NAT网关。取值：

true：是。
false（默认）：否。

<notice>如果已经为VSwitchId参数配置的交换机开通了公网NAT网关，此参数值请选择false。></notice>
parameters.name: public_network_access_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the Internet NAT gateway. Valid values:

true: enable the Internet NAT gateway.
false (default): disable the Internet NAT gateway.

If an Internet NAT gateway is enabled for the vSwitch that you specify for VSwitchId, select false for this parameter
parameters.name: rag_enabled

fields.help_en: The instance type of the database instance.
fields.help_zh: 数据库实例的实例规格
fields.name: db_instance_class

fields.help_en: The storage capacity of the database instance.
fields.name: db_instance_storage

fields.help_en: The payment type of the database instance.
fields.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the RDS for PostgreSQL instance
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启公网连接地址，取值：

true（默认）：是。

false：否
parameters.name: public_endpoint_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable public endpoint.

true (default)
false
parameters.help_zh:
是否从已有PG数据中恢复，取值：

true：是。

false（默认）：否
parameters.name: initialize_with_existing_data

InstanceName.description_en: The ID of the RDS Supabase instance
